title: First conditional if...will · 综合测试
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为综合测试练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。
points: if + subject + present
main clause subject + will + base verb
the subordinate clause cannot use will
the if clause can come before or after
unless = if...not

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

examples.en: We will miss the train if we are late.
examples.zh: 如果迟到我们就赶不上火车了。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你努力学习,就会通过考试。

examples.en: She will help you if you ask her.
examples.zh: 如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。

examples.en: If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.
examples.zh: 如果我们种更多的树,城市会更绿。

examples.en: You will feel better if you take a rest.
examples.zh: 如果你休息一下,会感觉好一些。

questions.prompt: If it _____ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
options: rains
rained
is raining
will rain
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。此处应为 rains。句意:如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We will miss the train if we were late.
We will miss the train if we would be late.
We will miss the train if we will be late.
We will miss the train if we are late.
questions.explanation: If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:We will miss the train if we are late.

questions.prompt: 「如果你努力学习,就会通过考试。」的正确英文是?
options: If you work hard, you would pass the exam.
If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
If you work hard, you passed the exam.
If you work hard, you pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:If you work hard, you will pass the exam.

questions.prompt: She will help you if you _____ her.
options: ask
would ask
asked
will ask
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。此处应为 ask。句意:如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If we would plant more trees, the city will be greener.
If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.
If we planted more trees, the city will be greener.
If we will plant more trees, the city will be greener.
questions.explanation: If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.

questions.prompt: 「如果你休息一下,会感觉好一些。」的正确英文是?
options: You will feel better if you took a rest.
You will feel better if you will take a rest.
You will feel better if you would take a rest.
You will feel better if you take a rest.
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:You will feel better if you take a rest.

title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 综合测试
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为综合测试练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
points: because answers why, strongest tone
since = since, based on a known fact
as = as, weakest tone
now that = since
when because is used, so is not used in the main clause

examples.en: Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.
examples.zh: 既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

examples.en: He didn't go to school because he was ill.
examples.zh: 他因为生病没去上学。

examples.en: As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
examples.zh: 由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

examples.en: Now that the work is done, you can rest.
examples.zh: 既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

examples.en: I stayed because the meeting was long.
examples.zh: 因为会议很长,我留下来了。

examples.en: Since you know the answer, please tell us.
examples.zh: 既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.
For that everyone is here, let's begin the class.
Because of everyone is here, let's begin the class.
As for everyone is here, let's begin the class.
questions.explanation: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.

questions.prompt: 「他因为生病没去上学。」的正确英文是?
options: He didn't go to school because he was ill.
He didn't go to school as for he was ill.
He didn't go to school so he was ill.
He didn't go to school because of he was ill.
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:He didn't go to school because he was ill.

questions.prompt: _____ it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
options: Because of
Since that
As
For
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 As。句意:由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Now what the work is done, you can rest.
For now the work is done, you can rest.
Because of the work is done, you can rest.
Now that the work is done, you can rest.
questions.explanation: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:Now that the work is done, you can rest.

questions.prompt: 「因为会议很长,我留下来了。」的正确英文是?
options: I stayed due the meeting was long.
I stayed because the meeting was long.
I stayed so the meeting was long.
I stayed because of the meeting was long.
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:I stayed because the meeting was long.

questions.prompt: _____ you know the answer, please tell us.
options: Because of
So
Since
For
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Since。句意:既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 综合测试
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为综合测试练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。
points: although = though, placed at the start
the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still
even though has a stronger tone
though can appear at the end of a sentence
despite/in spite of + noun also express concession

examples.en: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
examples.zh: 虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

examples.en: Though he is young, he knows a lot.
examples.zh: 虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she kept working.
examples.zh: 虽然她很累,仍继续工作。

examples.en: Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
examples.zh: 尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

examples.en: He passed the exam though he was ill.
examples.zh: 虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

examples.en: Although the shop is small, it has everything.
examples.zh: 这家店虽然小,但什么都有。

questions.prompt: 「虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。」的正确英文是?
options: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
Even it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
Although but it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
Despite it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.

questions.prompt: _____ he is young, he knows a lot.
options: Though
Though but
Despite
Even
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Though。句意:虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Although she was tired, she was keeping working.
Although she was tired, she but kept working.
Although she was tired, she keeps working.
Although she was tired, she kept working.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although she was tired, she kept working.

questions.prompt: 「尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。」的正确英文是?
options: Despite the task was hard, we finished it.
Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
Although but the task was hard, we finished it.
Even the task was hard, we finished it.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Even though the task was hard, we finished it.

questions.prompt: He passed the exam _____ he was ill.
options: despite
though
but
however
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 though。句意:虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: However the shop is small, it has everything.
Although but the shop is small, it has everything.
Although the shop is small, it has everything.
Despite the shop is small, it has everything.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although the shop is small, it has everything.

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 综合测试
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为综合测试练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。
points: to + base verb is the most common
in order to emphasizes purpose
so as to / in order to can be placed at the start
so that + subject + can/may + base verb
in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose

examples.en: I got up early to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 我早起是为了赶上头班车。

examples.en: She studies hard in order to go to college.
examples.zh: 她努力学习是为了上大学。

examples.en: We speak slowly so that everyone can follow.
examples.zh: 我们说得慢,好让每个人都能跟上。

examples.en: He saved money to buy a new bike.
examples.zh: 他攒钱是为了买一辆新自行车。

examples.en: I wrote it down in order not to forget.
examples.zh: 我记下来是为了不忘记。

examples.en: They plant trees to make the city greener.
examples.zh: 他们种树是为了让城市更绿。

questions.prompt: I got up early _____ the first bus.
options: for catch
to catch
catch
to catching
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 to catch。句意:我早起是为了赶上头班车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She studies hard so as go to college.
She studies hard in order to go to college.
She studies hard in order that to go to college.
She studies hard for go to college.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:She studies hard in order to go to college.

questions.prompt: 「我们说得慢,好让每个人都能跟上。」的正确英文是?
options: We speak slowly because everyone can follow.
We speak slowly so as everyone can follow.
We speak slowly in order everyone can follow.
We speak slowly so that everyone can follow.
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:We speak slowly so that everyone can follow.

questions.prompt: He saved money _____ a new bike.
options: to buy
for buy
buy
to buying
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 to buy。句意:他攒钱是为了买一辆新自行车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I wrote it down in order to not forget.
I wrote it down for not forget.
I wrote it down in order not to forget.
I wrote it down so that not to forget.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:I wrote it down in order not to forget.

questions.prompt: 「他们种树是为了让城市更绿。」的正确英文是?
options: They plant trees to making the city greener.
They plant trees for make the city greener.
They plant trees to make the city greener.
They plant trees make the city greener.
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:They plant trees to make the city greener.

title: Infinitives as object want to do · 综合测试
summary: Verbs like want, decide, hope, plan, promise are followed by the infinitive as object.本课为综合测试练习,核心:want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。
points: want to do = want to do something
decide to do = decide to do something
hope to do / plan to do / agree to do
would like to do expresses a polite wish
enjoy/finish/mind take V-ing instead

examples.en: I want to buy a new dictionary.
examples.zh: 我想买一本新词典。

examples.en: She decided to learn art by herself.
examples.zh: 她决定自学美术。

examples.en: We hope to visit London next year.
examples.zh: 我们希望明年去伦敦。

examples.en: They plan to build a small garden.
examples.zh: 他们计划建一个小花园。

examples.en: He promised to help me with science.
examples.zh: 他答应帮我学科学。

examples.en: Would you like to join our club?
examples.zh: 你愿意加入我们的社团吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I want to buying a new dictionary.
I want to buy a new dictionary.
I want buy a new dictionary.
I want buying a new dictionary.
questions.explanation: want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:I want to buy a new dictionary.

questions.prompt: 「她决定自学美术。」的正确英文是?
options: She decided to learning art by herself.
She decided learn art by herself.
She decided learning art by herself.
She decided to learn art by herself.
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:She decided to learn art by herself.

questions.prompt: We hope _____ London next year.
options: visiting
to visiting
visit
to visit
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。此处应为 to visit。句意:我们希望明年去伦敦。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They plan to build a small garden.
They plan build a small garden.
They plan to building a small garden.
They plan building a small garden.
questions.explanation: want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:They plan to build a small garden.

questions.prompt: 「他答应帮我学科学。」的正确英文是?
options: He promised to help me with science.
He promised helping me with science.
He promised to helping me with science.
He promised help me with science.
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:He promised to help me with science.

questions.prompt: Would you like _____ our club?
options: to join
joining
to joining
join
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。此处应为 to join。句意:你愿意加入我们的社团吗?

title: Gerunds as object enjoy doing · 综合测试
summary: Verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep are followed by the gerund as object.本课为综合测试练习,核心:enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。
points: enjoy doing = enjoy something
finish doing = finish doing something
practice doing / keep doing
mind doing (used in questions)
stop doing stops the current action; stop to do stops in order to do something else

examples.en: I enjoy reading books about science.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读关于科学的书。

examples.en: She finished writing the letter at ten.
examples.zh: 她十点写完了信。

examples.en: We practice speaking English every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早上练习说英语。

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
examples.zh: 你介意打开窗户吗?

examples.en: He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 他坚持锻炼以保持健康。

examples.en: They stopped talking when the teacher came in.
examples.zh: 老师进来时他们停止了交谈。

questions.prompt: 「我喜欢读关于科学的书。」的正确英文是?
options: I enjoy to read books about science.
I enjoy read books about science.
I enjoy to reading books about science.
I enjoy reading books about science.
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:I enjoy reading books about science.

questions.prompt: She finished _____ the letter at ten.
options: to writing
writing
write
to write
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。此处应为 writing。句意:她十点写完了信。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We practice to speak English every morning.
We practice to speaking English every morning.
We practice speak English every morning.
We practice speaking English every morning.
questions.explanation: enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:We practice speaking English every morning.

questions.prompt: 「你介意打开窗户吗?」的正确英文是?
options: Would you mind open the window?
Would you mind opening the window?
Would you mind to open the window?
Would you mind to opening the window?
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:Would you mind opening the window?

questions.prompt: He keeps _____ exercise to stay healthy.
options: do
to doing
doing
to do
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。此处应为 doing。句意:他坚持锻炼以保持健康。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They stopped talk when the teacher came in.
They stopped to talk when the teacher came in.
They stopped to talking when the teacher came in.
They stopped talking when the teacher came in.
questions.explanation: enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:They stopped talking when the teacher came in.

title: Gerunds after prepositions · 综合测试
summary: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。
points: be good at + V-ing
be interested in + V-ing
instead of + V-ing
look forward to + V-ing (to is a preposition)
before/after + V-ing as object

examples.en: She is good at drawing pictures.
examples.zh: 她擅长画画。

examples.en: I am interested in learning science.
examples.zh: 我对学科学感兴趣。

examples.en: He went out instead of doing homework.
examples.zh: 他没有做作业,而是出去了。

examples.en: We look forward to seeing you again.
examples.zh: 我们期待再见到你。

examples.en: Wash your hands before eating.
examples.zh: 饭前要洗手。

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with the work.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我做这项工作。

questions.prompt: She is good at _____ pictures.
options: draws
to draw
drawing
draw
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 drawing。句意:她擅长画画。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I am interested in to learn science.
I am interested in learn science.
I am interested in learning science.
I am interested in learns science.
questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:I am interested in learning science.

questions.prompt: 「他没有做作业,而是出去了。」的正确英文是?
options: He went out instead of do homework.
He went out instead of doing homework.
He went out instead of to do homework.
He went out instead of does homework.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:He went out instead of doing homework.

questions.prompt: We look forward to _____ you again.
options: seeing
see
sees
to see
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 seeing。句意:我们期待再见到你。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Wash your hands before to eat.
Wash your hands before eat.
Wash your hands before eating.
Wash your hands before eats.
questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:Wash your hands before eating.

questions.prompt: 「谢谢你帮我做这项工作。」的正确英文是?
options: Thank you for helping me with the work.
Thank you for help me with the work.
Thank you for helps me with the work.
Thank you for to help me with the work.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:Thank you for helping me with the work.

title: so...that / too...to / enough to · 综合测试
summary: Three result structures: so...that, too...to (negative meaning), enough to (affirmative meaning).本课为综合测试练习,核心:so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。
points: so + adjective/adorb + that clause
too + adjective + to do = too...to
adjective + enough + to do = enough to...
so that can also express purpose
such + noun phrase + that, distinguished from so

examples.en: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了,我搬不动。

examples.en: He is too young to drive a car.
examples.zh: 他太年轻,不能开车。

examples.en: She is old enough to go to school.
examples.zh: 她到上学的年龄了。

examples.en: The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
examples.zh: 这道题太难了,没人答出来。

examples.en: It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.
examples.zh: 这本书如此有趣,我读了两遍。

examples.en: He ran fast enough to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is such heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is heavy so that I can't carry it.
The box is too heavy that that I can't carry it.
questions.explanation: so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.

questions.prompt: 「他太年轻,不能开车。」的正确英文是?
options: He is so young to drive a car.
He is young enough to drive a car.
He is such young to drive a car.
He is too young to drive a car.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:He is too young to drive a car.

questions.prompt: She is _____ to go to school.
options: old enough
so old
enough old
too old
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 old enough。句意:她到上学的年龄了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The question was difficult so that nobody answered it.
The question was too difficult that that nobody answered it.
The question was such difficult that nobody answered it.
The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
questions.explanation: so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.

questions.prompt: 「这本书如此有趣,我读了两遍。」的正确英文是?
options: It is too an interesting book that I read it twice.
It is very an interesting book that I read it twice.
It is so an interesting book that I read it twice.
It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.

questions.prompt: He ran _____ to catch the bus.
options: too fast
so fast
enough fast
fast enough
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 fast enough。句意:他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

title: Tag questions · 综合测试
summary: Tag questions: front affirmative, tag negative, and vice versa; reuse the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。
points: front affirmative, tag negative
front negative, tag affirmative
the tag uses the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause
Let's..., shall we?
an imperative sentence uses will you

examples.en: You are a student, aren't you?
examples.zh: 你是学生,不是吗?

examples.en: She doesn't like soup, does she?

examples.en: They went to the park yesterday, didn't they?

examples.en: He can swim well, can't he?
examples.zh: 他游泳游得很好,不是吗?

questions.prompt: 「你是学生,不是吗?」的正确英文是?

You are a student, isn't you?
You are a student, are you?
You are a student, aren't you?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:You are a student, aren't you?

questions.prompt: She doesn't like soup, _____?
options: does she
did she
doesn't she
is she
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 does she。句意:她不喜欢汤,对吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They went to the park yesterday, didn't they?
They went to the park yesterday, weren't they?
They went to the park yesterday, did they?
They went to the park yesterday, don't they?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:They went to the park yesterday, didn't they?

questions.prompt: 「他游泳游得很好,不是吗?」的正确英文是?
options: He can swim well, can he?
He can swim well, can't he?
He can swim well, isn't he?
He can swim well, does he?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:He can swim well, can't he?

questions.prompt: Let's take a walk after dinner, _____?
options: shall we
will we
shant we
do we
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 shall we。句意:晚饭后我们散散步,好吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Close the door, will you?
Close the door, do you?
Close the door, shall you?
Close the door, won't I?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:Close the door, will you?

title: Exclamatory sentences What / How · 综合测试
summary: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为综合测试练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。
points: What a/an + adjective + singular noun
What + adjective + plural noun
How + adjective/adorb + subject + verb
the exclamatory word must be placed before the phrase it modifies
an exclamatory sentence can omit the subject and verb

examples.en: What a beautiful day it is!
examples.zh: 多么美好的一天啊!

examples.en: What lovely flowers they are!
examples.zh: 多么可爱的花啊!

examples.en: How fast he runs!
examples.zh: 他跑得真快!

examples.en: What an interesting book this is!
examples.zh: 这是一本多么有趣的书啊!

examples.en: How time flies!
examples.zh: 时间过得多快啊!

examples.en: What good news it is!
examples.zh: 多么好的消息啊!

questions.prompt: _____ beautiful day it is!
options: How a
What
How
What a
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。此处应为 What a。句意:多么美好的一天啊!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: What lovely flowers they are!
What a lovely flowers they are!
How lovely flowers they are!
How a lovely flowers they are!
questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What lovely flowers they are!

questions.prompt: 「他跑得真快!」的正确英文是?
options: How fast he runs!
What fast he runs!
What a fast he runs!
So fast he runs!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:How fast he runs!

questions.prompt: _____ interesting book this is!
options: What an
What a
How
So an
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。此处应为 What an。句意:这是一本多么有趣的书啊!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: So time flies!
What a time flies!
What time flies!
How time flies!
questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:How time flies!

questions.prompt: 「多么好的消息啊!」的正确英文是?
options: How a good news it is!
How good news it is!
What a good news it is!
What good news it is!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What good news it is!

title: both / either / neither · 综合测试
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为综合测试练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is
the subject connected by either...or agrees with the nearer one (proximity principle)

examples.en: Both of my parents like traveling.
examples.zh: 我的父母都喜欢旅行。

examples.en: Neither of the answers is right.
examples.zh: 两个答案都不对。

examples.en: You can take either of the two books.
examples.zh: 这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

examples.en: Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他妹妹都不在家。

examples.en: Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
examples.zh: 莉莉和汤姆都在二班。

examples.en: Either you or he has to clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 要么你要么他得打扫教室。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Both of my parents like traveling.
All of my parents like traveling.
Neither of my parents like traveling.
Either of my parents like traveling.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both of my parents like traveling.

questions.prompt: 「两个答案都不对。」的正确英文是?
options: Neither of the answers be right.
Neither of the answers were right.
Neither of the answers are right.
Neither of the answers is right.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither of the answers is right.

questions.prompt: You can take _____ of the two books.
options: both
either
neither
all
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 either。句意:这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Neither Tom nor his sister is being at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister are at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister were at home.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.

questions.prompt: 「莉莉和汤姆都在二班。」的正确英文是?
options: Either Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Neither Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
All Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.

questions.prompt: Either you or he _____ to clean the classroom.
options: having
has
have
are
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 has。句意:要么你要么他得打扫教室。

title: used to past habits · 综合测试
summary: used to expresses a past habit or state that no longer exists.本课为综合测试练习,核心:used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。
points: used to + base verb
the negative is didn't use to / used not to
the question is Did...use to...?
be used to + V-ing = accustomed to (different meaning)
often contrasted with now

examples.en: He used to play table tennis after school.
examples.zh: 他过去放学后常打乒乓球。

examples.en: There used to be a shop at the corner.
examples.zh: 街角过去有一家商店。

examples.en: She didn't use to like chicken.
examples.zh: 她过去不喜欢鸡肉。

examples.en: I am used to getting up early now.
examples.zh: 我现在习惯早起。

examples.en: Did you use to live in Xi'an?
examples.zh: 你过去住在西安吗?

examples.en: We used to walk to school together.
examples.zh: 我们过去常一起步行上学。

questions.prompt: 「他过去放学后常打乒乓球。」的正确英文是?
options: He used to play table tennis after school.
He use to play table tennis after school.
He used to playing table tennis after school.
He was used to play table tennis after school.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:He used to play table tennis after school.

questions.prompt: There _____ a shop at the corner.
options: was used to be
used to be
use to be
used to being
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 used to be。句意:街角过去有一家商店。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She didn't used to like chicken.
She didn't using to like chicken.
She didn't use to like chicken.
She didn't used like chicken.
questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:She didn't use to like chicken.

questions.prompt: 「我现在习惯早起。」的正确英文是?
options: I am used to get up early now.
I am used to to get up early now.
I am used to gets up early now.
I am used to getting up early now.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:I am used to getting up early now.

questions.prompt: Did you _____ live in Xi'an?
options: using to
used to
used
use to
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 use to。句意:你过去住在西安吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We used to walk to school together.
We used to walking to school together.
We were used to walk to school together.
We use to walk to school together.
questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:We used to walk to school together.

title: as...as comparisons · 综合测试
summary: as...as expresses 'as...as'; the negative not as...as means 'not as...as'.本课为综合测试练习,核心:as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。
points: as + adjective base form + as
the negative is not as/so + adjective + as
the same...as = the same as
as...as possible = as...as possible
in the negative, the latter part means a downward comparison

examples.en: Tom is as tall as his brother.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他哥哥一样高。

examples.en: This bag is not as expensive as that one.
examples.zh: 这个包不如那个贵。

examples.en: Please come back as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快回来。

examples.en: She runs as fast as her sister.
examples.zh: 她跑得和她姐姐一样快。

examples.en: My phone is the same color as yours.
examples.zh: 我的手机和你的颜色一样。

examples.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天不如昨天冷。

questions.prompt: Tom is _____ his brother.
options: as tall as
tall as
as taller as
so tall as
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。此处应为 as tall as。句意:汤姆和他哥哥一样高。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: This bag is not expensive as that one.
This bag is not as expensive as that one.
This bag is not as expensiver as that one.
This bag is not so expensive than that one.
questions.explanation: as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:This bag is not as expensive as that one.

questions.prompt: 「请尽快回来。」的正确英文是?
options: Please come back so soon as possible.
Please come back as soon as can.
Please come back as sooner as possible.
Please come back as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:Please come back as soon as possible.

questions.prompt: She runs _____ her sister.
options: fast as
as faster as
as fast as
so fast as
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。此处应为 as fast as。句意:她跑得和她姐姐一样快。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: My phone is same like color as yours.
My phone is the same color as yours.
My phone is as same color as yours.
My phone is such same color as yours.
questions.explanation: as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:My phone is the same color as yours.

questions.prompt: 「今天不如昨天冷。」的正确英文是?
options: Today isn't as colder as yesterday.
Today isn't cold as yesterday.
Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
Today isn't so cold than yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:Today isn't as cold as yesterday.

title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 高频真题
summary: have/has + past participle expresses an action that happened in the past and its impact on the present.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。
points: have/has + past participle
often with already, yet, just, ever, never
the negative is haven't/hasn't + past participle
Have you ever...? asks about experience
distinguish from the past simple: no specific past time is given

examples.en: I have finished my homework already.
examples.zh: 我已经完成了作业。

examples.en: She has lived here for ten years.
examples.zh: 她在这里住了十年了。

examples.en: The visitors have arrived at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 访客已经到达超市。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Xi'an?
examples.zh: 你去过西安吗?

examples.en: He hasn't seen this movie yet.
examples.zh: 他还没看过这部电影。

examples.en: We have known each other since 2018.
examples.zh: 我们从2018年起就认识。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I finished have my homework already.
I have finish my homework already.
I have finished my homework already.
I has finished my homework already.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:I have finished my homework already.

questions.prompt: 「她在这里住了十年了。」的正确英文是?
options: She has lived here for ten years.
She lived has here for ten years.
She has live here for ten years.
She have lived here for ten years.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:She has lived here for ten years.

questions.prompt: The visitors _____ at the supermarket.
options: arrived have
has arrived
have arrived
have arrive
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。此处应为 have arrived。句意:访客已经到达超市。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Have you ever being to Xi'an?
Have you ever gone to Xi'an?
Have you ever went to Xi'an?
Have you ever been to Xi'an?
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:Have you ever been to Xi'an?

questions.prompt: 「他还没看过这部电影。」的正确英文是?
options: He hasn't seen this movie yet.
He hasn't seeing this movie yet.
He hasn't saw this movie yet.
He hasn't see this movie yet.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:He hasn't seen this movie yet.

questions.prompt: We _____ each other since 2018.
options: have known
know have
have knew
has known
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。此处应为 have known。句意:我们从2018年起就认识。

title: Present perfect vs past simple · 高频真题
summary: Determine the tense by whether there is a past time adverbial and whether the present result matters.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。
points: with yesterday, last year, in 2010 use the past simple
with already, yet, so far use the present perfect
just now = just a moment ago, use the past simple; just = just now, use the present perfect
have been to = went and came back; have gone to = went and hasn't returned
when asking about experience use Have you ever...

examples.en: I saw this movie last week.
examples.zh: 我上周看了这部电影。

examples.en: She has lost her keys and can't open the door.
examples.zh: 她丢了钥匙,打不开门。

examples.en: Lily went to Xi'an in 2019.
examples.zh: 莉莉2019年去了西安。

examples.en: He has worked here since last year.
examples.zh: 他从去年起一直在这里工作。

examples.en: They came back just now.
examples.zh: 他们刚回来。

examples.en: So far we have learned five units.
examples.zh: 到目前为止我们学了五个单元。

questions.prompt: 「我上周看了这部电影。」的正确英文是?
options: I have seen this movie last week.
I has seen this movie last week.
I see this movie last week.
I saw this movie last week.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:I saw this movie last week.

questions.prompt: She _____ her keys and can't open the door.
options: lost
has lost
loses
have lost
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。此处应为 has lost。句意:她丢了钥匙,打不开门。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Lily has been to Xi'an in 2019.
Lily has gone to Xi'an in 2019.
Lily goes to Xi'an in 2019.
Lily went to Xi'an in 2019.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:Lily went to Xi'an in 2019.

questions.prompt: 「他从去年起一直在这里工作。」的正确英文是?
options: He worked here since last year.
He has worked here since last year.
He have worked here since last year.
He is working here since last year.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:He has worked here since last year.

questions.prompt: They _____ back just now.
options: has come
come
came
have come
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。此处应为 came。句意:他们刚回来。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: So far we have learned five units.
So far we has learned five units.
So far we learn five units.
So far we learned five units.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:So far we have learned five units.

title: for / since time phrases · 高频真题
summary: The time adverbials of the present perfect: for takes a duration, since takes a starting point.本课为高频真题练习,核心:for + length of time; since + point in time。
points: for + a period: for two years
since + a point in time: since 2020
since + clause: since he left
How long...? asks about duration
The main clause of for/since phrases often uses the perfect tense

examples.en: We have studied English for six years.
examples.zh: 我们学英语六年了。

examples.en: She has been in this school since 2021.
examples.zh: 她从2021年起就在这所学校。

examples.en: I haven't seen him since last February.
examples.zh: 自上二月以来我一直没见过他。

examples.en: They have lived here for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们在这里住了很久了。

examples.en: How long have you kept this hobby?
examples.zh: 这个爱好你保持多久了?

examples.en: Much has changed since we met.
examples.zh: 自从我们认识后,变化很大。

questions.prompt: We have studied English _____ six years.
options: in
at
since
for
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。此处应为 for。句意:我们学英语六年了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She has been in this school since 2021.
She has been in this school for 2021.
She has been in this school at 2021.
She has been in this school from 2021.
questions.explanation: for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:She has been in this school since 2021.

questions.prompt: 「自上二月以来我一直没见过他。」的正确英文是?
options: I haven't seen him during last February.
I haven't seen him since last February.
I haven't seen him in last February.
I haven't seen him for last February.
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:I haven't seen him since last February.

questions.prompt: They have lived here _____ a long time.
options: during
since
before
for
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。此处应为 for。句意:他们在这里住了很久了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: How long have you kept this hobby?
How long have you keeped this hobby?
How long have you keep this hobby?
How long have you keeping this hobby?
questions.explanation: for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:How long have you kept this hobby?

questions.prompt: 「自从我们认识后,变化很大。」的正确英文是?
options: Much has changed since we met.
Much has changed from we met.
Much has changed for we met.
Much has changed by we met.
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:Much has changed since we met.

title: Past continuous · 高频真题
summary: The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为高频真题练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。
points: was + V-ing (I/he/she/it)
were + V-ing (you/we/they)
often with at that time, at eight last night
the negative is was/were not + V-ing
the question moves was/were before the subject

examples.en: I was reading at nine last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚九点我正在读书。

examples.en: They were playing chess at that time.
examples.zh: 那时他们正在打国际象棋。

examples.zh: 我打电话时她正在做面包。

examples.en: We were walking to the museum in the rain.
examples.zh: 我们那时正冒雨走向博物馆。

examples.en: He wasn't watching TV at eight last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚八点他没在看电视。

examples.en: What were you doing at noon yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天中午你在做什么?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I was reading at nine last night.
I was read at nine last night.
I were reading at nine last night.
I read at nine last night.
questions.explanation: was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:I was reading at nine last night.

questions.prompt: 「那时他们正在打国际象棋。」的正确英文是?
options: They were playing chess at that time.
They were play chess at that time.
They played chess at that time.
They was playing chess at that time.
questions.explanation: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:They were playing chess at that time.

questions.prompt: She _____ bread when I called.
options: cooked
was cook
was cooking
were cooking
questions.explanation: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。此处应为 was cooking。句意:我打电话时她正在做面包。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We were walking to the museum in the rain.
We was walking to the museum in the rain.

title: First conditional if...will · 阶段复盘
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。

the subordinate clause cannot use will

unless = if...not

title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 阶段复盘
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
points: because answers why, strongest tone
since = since, based on a known fact
as = as, weakest tone
now that = since
when because is used, so is not used in the main clause

examples.zh: 既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

examples.zh: 既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

questions.prompt: _____ you know the answer, please tell us.

questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Since。句意:既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 阶段复盘
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。
points: although = though, placed at the start
the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still
even though has a stronger tone
though can appear at the end of a sentence
despite/in spite of + noun also express concession

questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Even though the task was hard, we finished it.

questions.prompt: He passed the exam _____ he was ill.
options: however

questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 though。句意:虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

options: However the shop is small, it has everything.

Although the shop is small, it has everything.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although the shop is small, it has everything.

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 阶段复盘
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。
points: to + base verb is the most common
