It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.

questions.prompt: He ran _____ to catch the bus.
options: enough fast
too fast
fast enough
so fast
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 fast enough。句意:他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

title: Tag questions · 阶段复盘
summary: Tag questions: front affirmative, tag negative, and vice versa; reuse the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。
points: front affirmative, tag negative
front negative, tag affirmative
the tag uses the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause
Let's..., shall we?
an imperative sentence uses will you

examples.en: You are a student, aren't you?
examples.zh: 你是学生,不是吗?

examples.en: She doesn't like noodles, does she?
examples.zh: 她不喜欢面条,对吗?

examples.en: They went to the library yesterday, didn't they?
examples.zh: 他们昨天去了图书馆,不是吗?

examples.en: He can swim well, can't he?
examples.zh: 他游泳游得很好,不是吗?

examples.en: Let's take a walk after dinner, shall we?
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们散散步,好吗?

examples.en: Close the door, will you?
examples.zh: 把门关上,好吗?

questions.prompt: 「你是学生,不是吗?」的正确英文是?
options: You are a student, are you?
You are a student, don't you?
You are a student, aren't you?
You are a student, isn't you?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:You are a student, aren't you?

questions.prompt: She doesn't like noodles, _____?
options: is she
did she
does she
doesn't she
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 does she。句意:她不喜欢面条,对吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They went to the library yesterday, weren't they?
They went to the library yesterday, did they?
They went to the library yesterday, didn't they?
They went to the library yesterday, don't they?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:They went to the library yesterday, didn't they?

questions.prompt: 「他游泳游得很好,不是吗?」的正确英文是?
options: He can swim well, can he?
He can swim well, can't he?
He can swim well, isn't he?
He can swim well, does he?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:He can swim well, can't he?

questions.prompt: Let's take a walk after dinner, _____?
options: will we
shant we
shall we
do we
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 shall we。句意:晚饭后我们散散步,好吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Close the door, won't I?
Close the door, do you?
Close the door, will you?
Close the door, shall you?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:Close the door, will you?

title: Exclamatory sentences What / How · 阶段复盘
summary: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。
points: What a/an + adjective + singular noun
What + adjective + plural noun
How + adjective/adorb + subject + verb
the exclamatory word must be placed before the phrase it modifies
an exclamatory sentence can omit the subject and verb

examples.en: What a beautiful day it is!
examples.zh: 多么美好的一天啊!

examples.en: What lovely flowers they are!
examples.zh: 多么可爱的花啊!

examples.en: How fast he runs!
examples.zh: 他跑得真快!

examples.en: What an interesting book this is!
examples.zh: 这是一本多么有趣的书啊!

examples.en: How time flies!
examples.zh: 时间过得多快啊!

examples.en: What good news it is!
examples.zh: 多么好的消息啊!

questions.prompt: _____ beautiful day it is!
options: What
How a
How
What a
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。此处应为 What a。句意:多么美好的一天啊!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: What a lovely flowers they are!
How lovely flowers they are!
What lovely flowers they are!
How a lovely flowers they are!
questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What lovely flowers they are!

questions.prompt: 「他跑得真快!」的正确英文是?
options: So fast he runs!
How fast he runs!
What a fast he runs!
What fast he runs!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:How fast he runs!

questions.prompt: _____ interesting book this is!
options: How
So an
What a
What an
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。此处应为 What an。句意:这是一本多么有趣的书啊!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: How time flies!
So time flies!
What time flies!
What a time flies!
questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:How time flies!

questions.prompt: 「多么好的消息啊!」的正确英文是?
options: What good news it is!
How good news it is!
What a good news it is!
How a good news it is!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What good news it is!

title: both / either / neither · 阶段复盘
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is
the subject connected by either...or agrees with the nearer one (proximity principle)

examples.en: Both of my parents like traveling.
examples.zh: 我的父母都喜欢旅行。

examples.en: Neither of the answers is right.
examples.zh: 两个答案都不对。

examples.en: You can take either of the two books.
examples.zh: 这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

examples.en: Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他妹妹都不在家。

examples.en: Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
examples.zh: 莉莉和汤姆都在二班。

examples.en: Either you or he has to clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 要么你要么他得打扫教室。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Either of my parents like traveling.
Neither of my parents like traveling.
Both of my parents like traveling.
All of my parents like traveling.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both of my parents like traveling.

questions.prompt: 「两个答案都不对。」的正确英文是?
options: Neither of the answers are right.
Neither of the answers be right.
Neither of the answers is right.
Neither of the answers were right.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither of the answers is right.

questions.prompt: You can take _____ of the two books.
options: neither
all
either
both
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 either。句意:这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Neither Tom nor his sister are at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister is being at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister were at home.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.

questions.prompt: 「莉莉和汤姆都在二班。」的正确英文是?
options: All Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Either Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Neither Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.

questions.prompt: Either you or he _____ to clean the classroom.
options: are
has
have
having
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 has。句意:要么你要么他得打扫教室。

title: used to past habits · 阶段复盘
summary: used to expresses a past habit or state that no longer exists.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。
points: used to + base verb
the negative is didn't use to / used not to
the question is Did...use to...?
be used to + V-ing = accustomed to (different meaning)
often contrasted with now

examples.en: He used to play basketball after school.
examples.zh: 他过去放学后常打篮球。

examples.en: There used to be a shop at the corner.
examples.zh: 街角过去有一家商店。

examples.en: She didn't use to like chicken.
examples.zh: 她过去不喜欢鸡肉。

examples.en: I am used to getting up early now.
examples.zh: 我现在习惯早起。

examples.en: Did you use to live in London?
examples.zh: 你过去住在伦敦吗?

examples.en: We used to walk to school together.
examples.zh: 我们过去常一起步行上学。

questions.prompt: 「他过去放学后常打篮球。」的正确英文是?
options: He use to play basketball after school.
He was used to play basketball after school.
He used to play basketball after school.
He used to playing basketball after school.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:He used to play basketball after school.

questions.prompt: There _____ a shop at the corner.
options: was used to be
used to be
use to be
used to being
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 used to be。句意:街角过去有一家商店。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She didn't use to like chicken.
She didn't using to like chicken.
She didn't used like chicken.
She didn't used to like chicken.
questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:She didn't use to like chicken.

questions.prompt: 「我现在习惯早起。」的正确英文是?
options: I am used to to get up early now.
I am used to gets up early now.
I am used to getting up early now.
I am used to get up early now.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:I am used to getting up early now.

questions.prompt: Did you _____ live in London?
options: used to
using to
use to
used
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 use to。句意:你过去住在伦敦吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We used to walk to school together.
We used to walking to school together.
We use to walk to school together.
We were used to walk to school together.
questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:We used to walk to school together.

title: as...as comparisons · 阶段复盘
summary: as...as expresses 'as...as'; the negative not as...as means 'not as...as'.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。
points: as + adjective base form + as
the negative is not as/so + adjective + as
the same...as = the same as
as...as possible = as...as possible
in the negative, the latter part means a downward comparison

examples.en: Tom is as tall as his brother.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他哥哥一样高。

examples.en: This bag is not as expensive as that one.
examples.zh: 这个包不如那个贵。

examples.en: Please come back as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快回来。

examples.en: She runs as fast as her sister.
examples.zh: 她跑得和她姐姐一样快。

examples.en: My phone is the same color as yours.
examples.zh: 我的手机和你的颜色一样。

examples.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天不如昨天冷。

questions.prompt: Tom is _____ his brother.
options: as taller as
so tall as
as tall as
tall as
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。此处应为 as tall as。句意:汤姆和他哥哥一样高。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: This bag is not as expensive as that one.
This bag is not expensive as that one.
This bag is not so expensive than that one.
This bag is not as expensiver as that one.
questions.explanation: as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:This bag is not as expensive as that one.

questions.prompt: 「请尽快回来。」的正确英文是?
options: Please come back as soon as can.
Please come back as soon as possible.
Please come back so soon as possible.
Please come back as sooner as possible.
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:Please come back as soon as possible.

questions.prompt: She runs _____ her sister.
options: so fast as
fast as
as fast as
as faster as
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。此处应为 as fast as。句意:她跑得和她姐姐一样快。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: My phone is as same color as yours.
My phone is the same color as yours.
My phone is such same color as yours.
My phone is same like color as yours.
questions.explanation: as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:My phone is the same color as yours.

questions.prompt: 「今天不如昨天冷。」的正确英文是?
options: Today isn't cold as yesterday.
Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
Today isn't as colder as yesterday.
Today isn't so cold than yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:Today isn't as cold as yesterday.

title: 长难句主干提取:嵌套从句拆解
summary: 学会在多层嵌套从句里先找到主句谓语,再逐层剥离从句,读懂 B2 长难句的第一课。
points: 先找"主谓宾"主干,从句先用括号括起来
一个句子只有一个主句谓语,其余动词都在从句或非谓语里
定语从句紧跟先行词,名词性从句充当主/宾/表
剥掉修饰成分(介词短语、插入语)再看句意
读不懂时先问:谁?做了什么?

examples.en: The idea that the committee proposed last week, which surprised everyone, was finally accepted.
examples.zh: 委员会上周提出的那个想法——它让所有人都吃了一惊——最终被接受了。

examples.en: What the report suggests is that we rewrite the budget before Friday.
examples.zh: 报告的建议是我们在周五前重写预算。

examples.en: The engineer who fixed the server that crashed twice won an award.
examples.zh: 修好那台崩了两次的服务器的工程师获了奖。

examples.en: Analysts believe that the strategy the company chose will fail.
examples.zh: 分析师认为公司选定的策略会失败。

examples.en: That she kept calm when the building shook was remarkable.
examples.zh: 大楼摇晃时她还能保持镇定,令人赞叹。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the main clause in "The fact that he lied, which we proved later, destroyed the trust"?
options: The fact destroyed the trust
he lied
we proved later
the fact that he lied
questions.explanation: 主干是 The fact ... destroyed the trust;两个从句只是修饰。

questions.prompt: In "What matters most is how we respond", the underlined parts "what matters most" and "how we respond" function as ___.
options: subject and predicative
object and adverbial
attribute and object
subject and object
questions.explanation: what 从句作主语,how 从句作表语。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct analysis of "The woman who called you said she would email the contract that you signed".
options: 两个定语从句 + 一个宾语从句
三个宾语从句
一个定语从句 + 一个宾语从句
没有从句,只有并列句
questions.explanation: who called you 和 that you signed 是定语从句,she would email... 是宾语从句。

questions.prompt: "___ surprised us was the speed of the change."
options: What
That
Which
It
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语且强调"内容",用 what 引导主语从句。

questions.prompt: Strip the modifiers: "The plan, despite its flaws, that the board approved in March has worked."
options: The plan has worked.
The board approved in March.
Despite its flaws.
The plan that the board approved.
questions.explanation: 去掉插入语和定语从句,主干是 The plan has worked。

questions.prompt: The sentence "I think that the team who wins tonight will qualify" contains ___ clauses.
options: three
two
four
one
questions.explanation: 宾语从句 that the team... will qualify 内又嵌一个定语从句 who wins tonight,共三个谓语结构分属两层嵌套。

title: 非限制性定语从句与介词 + 关系代词
summary: 用逗号隔开的"补充说明"从句,以及介词提前后的 which/whom 用法,让书面表达更地道。
points: 非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开,切掉后主句仍完整
非限制性从句不能用 that,指物用 which,指人用 who/whom
which 可以指代前面整个句子
介词 + which/whom:介词可提前,关系代词不可省略
whose 在两种从句里都表示"谁的"

examples.en: My laptop, which I bought in 2019, still runs perfectly.
examples.zh: 我 2019 年买的笔记本电脑至今运行流畅。

examples.en: She passed the interview, which surprised nobody.
examples.zh: 她通过了面试,没人觉得意外。(which 指代整句)

examples.en: The consultant with whom I worked has moved to Berlin.
examples.zh: 和我共事过的那位顾问搬去了柏林。

examples.en: The house whose windows face south stays warm all winter.
examples.zh: 窗户朝南的那座房子整个冬天都暖和。

examples.en: He gave three reasons, none of which convinced the board.
examples.zh: 他给了三条理由,没有一条能说服董事会。

questions.prompt: This dictionary, ___ I use almost daily, was a gift from my tutor.
options: that
which
what
who
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句不能用 that,指物用 which。

questions.prompt: The team lost in the final, ___ disappointed their fans deeply.
options: what
as
which
who
questions.explanation: which 在这里指代"输掉决赛"整件事。

questions.prompt: The partner ___ the firm merged with has rebranded.
options: whom
which
whose
where
questions.explanation: 先行词是人,作介词 with 的宾语,用 whom。

questions.prompt: She mentioned a mentor, ___ advice changed her career path.
options: who
whose
which
whom
questions.explanation: 表示"他/她的建议",用 whose。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where "in which" is used correctly.
options: The report in which the data appear was withdrawn.
The report in which I believe it
The city in which is famous for food
The year in which we moved in it
questions.explanation: "报告(数据出现在其中)被撤回",in which 指代 the report,结构正确。

questions.prompt: He tried yoga, ___ he had never done before.
options: which
that
what
in which
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句中指代瑜伽这件事,只能用 which。

title: 同位语从句与名词性从句进阶
summary: 分清 that 同位语从句与 that 定语从句,掌握 whether/if、疑问词引导的名词性从句的细节。
points: 同位语从句解释名词内容,that 不作成分、不可省略
定语从句中 that 作成分;同位语从句中 that 不作成分
常见同位语名词:fact, news, idea, belief, suggestion, doubt
主语从句可后置:It is clear that...
whether 引导从句可放句首,if 不行;介词后只用 whether

examples.en: The news that the flight had been cancelled spread quickly.
examples.zh: 航班取消的消息传得很快。

examples.en: It remains doubtful whether the funds will arrive on time.
examples.zh: 资金能否按时到位仍有疑问。

examples.en: Whoever breaks the rule pays the fine.
examples.zh: 谁违规谁交罚款。

examples.en: The suggestion that we postpone the launch was rejected.
examples.zh: 推迟发布的建议被否决了。

examples.en: That is exactly what the survey revealed.
examples.zh: 那正是调查揭示的结果。

questions.prompt: The fact ___ he resigned shocked the whole office.
options: which
that
what
whose
questions.explanation: 同位语从句,that 不作成分也不可省略。

questions.prompt: The promise ___ he made last year has been kept.
options: what
whose
that
who
questions.explanation: 定语从句:that 在从句中作 made 的宾语。

questions.prompt: ___ the delay was intentional is still unclear.
options: Whether
If
What
Which
questions.explanation: 句首的主语从句只能用 whether,不能用 if。

questions.prompt: It suddenly hit her ___ she had left the keys at the hotel.
options: that
what
which
whether
questions.explanation: It hit her that... 中 that 引导真正的主语从句。

questions.prompt: We are debating ___ to invest in new equipment or keep the cash.
options: if
that
whether
what
questions.explanation: whether...or 结构,且介词/不定式前不用 if。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with an appositive clause (同位语从句).
options: The belief that patience wins is old but true.
The book that she lent me is due.
The idea that you proposed sounds risky.
The man that called left a number.
questions.explanation: "耐心制胜"这一信念的内容,that 不作成分,是同位语从句;其余 that 都在从句中作成分。

title: 虚拟语气:与现在事实相反
summary: 从 if 条件句开始,掌握"现在不成立"的假设:从句过去式,主句 would + 动词原形。
points: 与现在相反:If + 过去式,主句 would/could/might + 原形
be 动词一律用 were(含 I/he/she)
从句与主句时间一致,不能混搭
unless = if...not,同样适用
省略 if 时 were 提前:Were I you, ...

examples.en: If I had more free time, I would learn the cello.
examples.zh: 如果我有更多空余时间,我就去学大提琴。

examples.en: If she were the manager, she would change the roster.
examples.zh: 如果她是经理,她会改排班表。

examples.en: If cars flew, traffic reports would be much shorter.
examples.zh: 如果汽车会飞,路况播报会短得多。

examples.en: I would fix it myself if I knew how.
examples.zh: 我要是会修,就自己动手了。

examples.en: Were I in charge, I would cancel the meeting.
examples.zh: 我要是负责人,就取消这个会。

questions.prompt: If I ___ taller, I would play basketball professionally.
options: am
was
were
be
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反,be 动词用 were。

questions.prompt: If we ___ a car, we would drive to the coast.
options: have
had
having
would have
questions.explanation: 从句用过去式 had。

questions.prompt: She would apply for the grant if she ___ the deadline.
options: knows
knew
known
would know
questions.explanation: 与现在相反,从句用过去式 knew。

questions.prompt: ___ I you, I would take the earlier train.
options: If
Were
Had
Should
questions.explanation: 省略 if 的倒装:Were I you, ...

questions.prompt: If he weren't so busy, he ___ join us for dinner.
options: will
would
had
is
questions.explanation: 主句用 would + 原形。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses an unreal present condition.
options: If dolphins ran the city, parking would be free.
If dolphins run the city, parking would be free.
If dolphins ran the city, parking will be free.
If dolphins have run the city, parking would be free.
questions.explanation: 从句过去式 ran + 主句 would be,时间一致、结构正确。

title: 虚拟语气:与过去事实相反
summary: 谈"当时没发生"的假设:从句 had + 过去分词,主句 would have + 过去分词。
points: 与过去相反:If + had done,主句 would/could/might have done
主句常见错误:would had done ❌
省略 if:Had you asked, ...
注意与"现在相反"区分:看时间状语
事后诸葛式的遗憾、道歉、复盘常用此结构

examples.en: If we had booked earlier, we would have got better seats.
examples.zh: 要是我们早点订票,座位会好得多。

examples.en: If the alarm had rung, I wouldn't have missed the train.
examples.zh: 要是闹钟响了,我就不会误火车。

examples.en: She could have won if she had entered the senior group.
examples.zh: 她要是报了成年组,本来是有机会赢的。

examples.en: Had they listened to the pilot study, the launch would not have flopped.
examples.zh: 要是他们听取试点研究的意见,发布就不会翻车。

examples.en: I would have called you, but my phone died.
examples.zh: 我本想给你打电话,可手机没电了。

questions.prompt: If you ___ me, I would have helped immediately.
options: asked
had asked
have asked
would ask
questions.explanation: 与过去相反,从句用 had asked。

questions.prompt: If the map had been accurate, we ___ lost.
options: wouldn't get
hadn't got
wouldn't have got
won't get
questions.explanation: 主句用 would not have got。

questions.prompt: ___ she known the truth, she would have stayed.
options: If
Were
Had
Should
questions.explanation: 省略 if 的倒装:Had she known...

questions.prompt: He would have joined us if his flight ___ delayed.
options: isn't
weren't
hadn't been
wouldn't be
questions.explanation: 与过去相反,从句用 hadn't been。

questions.prompt: I ___ the deadline if you hadn't reminded me.
options: would miss
would have missed
had missed
missed
questions.explanation: 与过去相反,主句用 would have missed。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: If the team had practised more, they would have won.
If the team practised more, they would have won.
If the team had practised more, they would win.
If the team would have practised more, they had won.
questions.explanation: 与过去相反:had practised + would have won。

title: 混合条件句与错综时间
summary: 当从句和主句的时间不一致:一个看过去,一个看现在,各用各的规则。
points: 从句过去 + 主句现在:If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
从句现在 + 主句过去(少见):If he were braver, he would have spoken up yesterday.
判断步骤:先定从句时间,再定主句时间
now, today, this week 提示主句指现在
yesterday, last year 提示指过去

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.zh: 我当年要是学了医,现在就是医生了。

examples.en: If she weren't so shy, she would have introduced herself at the party.
examples.zh: 她要不是那么腼腆,昨晚聚会上早就自我介绍了。

examples.en: If the bridge had been built, the village would have a link to the city today.
examples.zh: 桥要是当年修好了,村子今天就有进城的通道。

examples.en: He would be running the department now if he had stayed.
examples.zh: 他要是没走,现在正管着这个部门。

examples.en: If I were more organised, I would have filed the receipts last week.
examples.zh: 我要是更有条理,上周就把收据归档了。

questions.prompt: If we ___ the turning, we would be there by now.
options: hadn't missed
didn't miss
wouldn't miss
haven't missed
questions.explanation: 错过岔路是过去的事,主句 by now 指现在:hadn't missed。

questions.prompt: If he ___ a lighter pack, he would have summited yesterday.
options: carried
had carried
carries
would carry
questions.explanation: 主句 yesterday 指过去,与过去相反,从句用 had carried。

questions.prompt: She would have the invoice by now if the post ___ on strike.
options: weren't
hadn't been
isn't
wouldn't be
questions.explanation: 罢工发生在过去,主句 by now 指现在。

questions.prompt: If I ___ better at maps, I wouldn't have walked the wrong way last night.
options: am
was
were
had been
questions.explanation: 方向感差是现在的长期状态,用 were;last night 只是主句时间。

questions.prompt: Which sentence mixes times correctly?
options: If you had saved the file, we wouldn't be panicking now.
If you saved the file, we wouldn't be panicking now.
If you had saved the file, we wouldn't have panicked now.
If you would save the file, we aren't panicking now.
questions.explanation: 过去没存文件(had saved)+ 现在正慌(wouldn't be panicking now)。

questions.prompt: If the museum ___ free on Mondays, we would have gone last week.
options: were
had been
is
would be
questions.explanation: 长期政策属现在/一般情况,用 were;last week 是主句时间。

title: wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time
summary: 四种表达"愿望与不满"的虚拟句式:对现在的遗憾、对过去的悔意、对未来的期望。
points: wish + 过去式:对现在的愿望
wish + had done:对过去的遗憾;wish + would:对将来的期望/抱怨
would rather + 过去式:宁愿别人/别的事怎样
if only 比 wish 更强烈,结构相同
It's (high) time + 过去式:早该做某事了

examples.en: I wish I knew how to sail.
examples.zh: 真希望我会开帆船。

examples.en: She wishes she had kept the receipt.
examples.zh: 她真希望当时留了收据。

examples.en: I wish the neighbours would stop drilling at dawn.
examples.zh: 真希望邻居别在清晨钻孔。

examples.en: I'd rather you didn't mention the budget today.
examples.zh: 我宁愿你今天别提预算。

examples.en: It's high time we rewrote this manual.
examples.zh: 我们早该重写这本手册了。

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ more about wine.
options: know
knew
had known
would know
questions.explanation: 对现在的愿望,用过去式 knew。

questions.prompt: I wish we ___ the early train yesterday.
options: catch
caught
had caught
would catch
questions.explanation: 对过去的遗憾,用 had caught。

questions.prompt: If only she ___ quieter in the library!
options: is
were
had been
would be
questions.explanation: 对现在的愿望,be 用 were。

questions.prompt: I'd rather he ___ the news in person.
options: tells
told
had told
would tell
questions.explanation: would rather 接从句时用过去式 told 表现在/将来。

questions.prompt: It's time you ___ sending applications.
options: start
started
had started
would start
questions.explanation: It's time + 过去式 started。

questions.prompt: Which wish refers to the past?
options: I wish I had taken her advice.
I wish I were braver.
I wish it would stop raining.
I wish dogs could talk.
questions.explanation: had taken 表对过去的遗憾。

title: suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟
summary: 建议、要求、命令、坚持类动词后的 that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形,不受时态影响。
points: 一类动词:suggest, demand, insist, require, request, order, propose, recommend
从句谓语:should + 原形,should 常省略,只剩原形
主句过去时也不改变:She insisted that he be told.
相关名词(suggestion, demand)后的同位语从句同样用原形
insist on being right(坚持观点)不用虚拟:insist that he was honest

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he (should) cut down on caffeine.
examples.zh: 医生建议他少摄入咖啡因。

examples.en: She demanded that the contract be rewritten.
examples.zh: 她要求重写合同。

examples.en: The panel recommended that the funding be extended.
examples.zh: 评审组建议延长资助。

examples.en: It is essential that everyone arrive on time.
examples.zh: 每个人准时到场至关重要。

examples.en: My request that he wait outside went ignored.
examples.zh: 我请他在外面等的要求被无视了。

questions.prompt: The board demanded that the report ___ before Friday.
options: is submitted
be submitted
was submitted
were submitted
questions.explanation: demand 后的从句用 (should) be done,选 be submitted。

questions.prompt: She suggested that he ___ the client first.
options: calls
called
call
would call
questions.explanation: suggest 后从句用原形 call。

questions.prompt: It is vital that no one ___ the results early.
options: announces
announce
announced
would announce
questions.explanation: It is vital that... 后用原形 announce。

questions.prompt: The general ordered that the bridge ___ .
options: destroy
be destroyed
was destroyed
destroyed
questions.explanation: order 后从句用被动原形 be destroyed。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: The rule requires that each player wear a number.
The rule requires that each player wears a number.
The rule requires that each player is wearing a number.
The rule requires that each player wore a number.
questions.explanation: requires that + 主语 + (should) wear 原形。

questions.prompt: The manager insisted that the deadline ___ , and he was right to.
options: not be moved
was not moved
not moved
would not be moved
questions.explanation: insist 表"坚决要求"时从句用 not be moved。

title: 完全倒装
summary: 整个谓语提到主语前面的倒装:方位副词开头、here/there 开头、直接引语等场景。
points: 方位/地点状语开头(Here, There, Now, Then, 地点介词短语)+ 不及物动词 + 主语
主语是代词时不倒装:Here it comes.
直接引语后:asked/said the visitor
表"也"的 so/neither/nor 属部分倒装(下一课)
完全倒装常用于描写,让画面先入眼

examples.en: On the hill stands a lonely lighthouse.
examples.zh: 山上立着一座孤独的灯塔。

examples.en: Here comes the night bus.
examples.zh: 夜班公交来了。

examples.en: Behind the counter sat an old clockmaker.
examples.zh: 柜台后面坐着一位老钟表匠。

examples.en: "There's the receipt," said the cashier.
examples.zh: "收据在这儿。"收银员说。

examples.en: Then came the announcement everyone feared.
examples.zh: 接着来了那个所有人都怕的通知。

questions.prompt: At the end of the pier ___ a small fish stall.
options: is standing
stands
does stand
standing
questions.explanation: 地点状语开头,完全倒装:stands a stall。

questions.prompt: Here ___ the results you asked for.
options: come
comes
coming
does come
questions.explanation: 主语是 the results(复数),倒装后动词跟主语:come。

questions.prompt: Under the old bridge ___.
options: a narrow path runs
runs a narrow path
does a narrow path run
running a narrow path
questions.explanation: 地点状语 + 不及物动词:runs a narrow path。

questions.prompt: There ___ the last ferry of the day.
options: goes
go
going
is going
questions.explanation: There goes + 单数名词 the ferry。

questions.prompt: "Perfect timing," ___.
options: said the guide
the guide said
did the guide say
the guide says
questions.explanation: 直接引语后常用完全倒装 said the guide。

questions.prompt: Which sentence keeps normal order (不倒装)?
options: Here she comes at last.
Here comes she at last.
Here comes the bus at last.
There goes our train.
questions.explanation: 主语是代词 she 时不倒装:Here she comes。

title: 部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置
summary: 否定副词或 only 状语放在句首时,助动词提前形成部分倒装,以及 so/neither 表"也/也不"。
points: 否定词(Never, Seldom, Rarely, Hardly, Little, Not until, No sooner)开头 → 助动词提前
Only + 状语开头 → 部分倒装
So/Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语:表"某人也是/也不是"
Not until... did... ;No sooner had... than...
主句倒装,从句不倒装:Not until he called did I relax.

examples.en: Never had the village seen such a flood.
examples.zh: 村子从未见过这样的洪水。

examples.en: Only after the audit did the truth emerge.
examples.zh: 直到审计之后真相才浮出水面。

examples.en: Seldom does she miss a deadline.
examples.zh: 她很少误期。

examples.en: I've tried the blue route; so has my colleague.
examples.zh: 我试过蓝线,我同事也试过。

examples.en: Not until the fog lifted did the ferries restart.
examples.zh: 雾散之后渡轮才恢复。

questions.prompt: Never in my life ___ such a storm.
options: I have seen
have I seen
I saw
did I saw
questions.explanation: Never 开头,部分倒装:have I seen。

questions.prompt: Only when the results came in ___ the mistake.
options: we noticed
did we notice
we did notice
noticed we
questions.explanation: Only + 状语从句开头,主句倒装:did we notice。

questions.prompt: No sooner ___ the stage than the power failed.
options: she had stepped
had she stepped
did she step
she stepped
questions.explanation: No sooner had... than 固定倒装。

questions.prompt: Hardly ___ the door when the phone rang.
options: he had closed
had he closed
he closed
did he closed
questions.explanation: Hardly had... when 倒装。

questions.prompt: I don't trust the forecast, and ___ my skipper.
options: so doesn't
neither does
neither do
so does
questions.explanation: 表"也不"用 neither + 助动词;主语 my skipper 是第三人称单数:neither does。

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the inversion in the right clause?
options: Not until she smiled did I sit down.
Not until she did smile I sat down.
Not until did she smile I sat down.
Not until she smiled I did sit down.
questions.explanation: Not until 时间从句不倒装,主句倒装:did I sit down。

title: as 引导的倒装与比较结构
summary: as/though 让步从句的倒装,以及 the more... the more、no more... than 等比较句式。
points: as/though 让步:形容词/副词/名词提前 + as/though + 主谓
Try as I might...;Cold as it was...
the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...
no more... than = 和……一样不
比较的对象要对应:than mine / than I did

examples.en: Tired as she was, she kept the shop open.
examples.zh: 她虽然很累,还是让店开着门。

examples.en: Try as he might, the engine wouldn't start.
examples.zh: 他怎么折腾,发动机就是不着火。

examples.en: The higher we climbed, the thinner the air became.
examples.zh: 我们爬得越高,空气越稀薄。

examples.en: Child as he was, he asked razor-sharp questions.
examples.zh: 他虽是个孩子,问题却尖刻犀利。

examples.en: The new printer is no more reliable than the old one.
examples.zh: 新打印机和旧的一样不可靠。

questions.prompt: ___ as the night was, the café stayed full.
options: Cold
Coldly
Colder
Coldest
questions.explanation: 让步倒装:形容词原形提前,Cold as the night was。

questions.prompt: Try ___ she might, the jar refused to open.
options: as
though
if
that
questions.explanation: Try as sb might 是让步倒装的固定搭配。

questions.prompt: The more data we collect, ___ the pattern becomes.
options: clear
clearer
clearest
more clearly
questions.explanation: the + 比较级,the + 比较级:clearer。

questions.prompt: ___ as he was, the apprentice spotted the flaw at once.
options: A child
Child
The child
Children
questions.explanation: 单数名词提前时省冠词:Child as he was。

questions.prompt: My commute is no shorter ___.
options: than mine
than yours
as yours
than you take the bus
questions.explanation: 比较对象要对应:than yours(your commute)。

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses concessive inversion correctly?
options: Much as I admire her, I disagree.
As much I admire her, I disagree.
Much I admire as her, I disagree.
I admire as much her, much I disagree.
questions.explanation: 副词 Much 提前 + as + 主谓,是让步倒装的正确形式。

title: 强调句型:It is ... that ...
summary: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分:强调主语、宾语、状语,让重点凸出来。
points: 强调人可用 who,其余一律用 that
去掉 It is...that 句子仍完整——这是强调句的判断标准
强调状语:It was in 2019 that...
不能强调谓语;强调谓语用 do/does/did
疑问式:Was it you that...? / Who was it that...?

examples.en: It was the intern who spotted the error.
examples.zh: 正是那位实习生发现了错误。

examples.en: It was on the night ferry that they first met.
examples.zh: 他们正是在夜班渡轮上初次相遇。

examples.en: It isn't the price that worries me; it's the fit.
examples.zh: 让我担心的不是价格,是合不合身。

examples.en: It was only last week that she changed her mind.
examples.zh: 就在上周她才改的主意。

examples.en: I did send the reminder — twice.
examples.zh: 我确实发了提醒——发了两次。(do 强调)

questions.prompt: It was the recipe ___ saved the dinner.
options: who
that
which
what
questions.explanation: 强调事物用 that。

questions.prompt: It was ___ who broke the silence, not me.
options: he
him
his
himself
questions.explanation: 强调句中用主格 he(后面 not me 是口语惯用补充)。

questions.prompt: ___ you that left the window open?
options: It was
Was it
There was
Is there
questions.explanation: 强调句的一般疑问式:Was it you that...?

questions.prompt: It was in the attic ___ the letters turned up.
options: where
that
which
when
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语用 that,不用 where。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a cleft sentence (强调句)?
options: It was the coach that changed everything.
It was obvious that the coach was tired.
It was the coach who was tired that day.
It seems that the coach changed his mind.
questions.explanation: 去掉 It was...that 后 The coach changed everything 仍完整,是强调句。

questions.prompt: I ___ warn them, but they laughed.
options: do
did
was
had
questions.explanation: 强调过去动作的谓语用 did。

title: 省略:让句子更简洁
summary: 状语从句中的主语 + be 省略、并列句的省略、不定式省略 to 等,书面口语都常用。
points: 状语从句:主语与主句一致且含 be 时,可省"主语 + be"
While waiting, ... = While (I was) waiting, ...
并列句省略相同成分:She can cook; he can't (cook).
不定式作表语/宾补时,省略 to do 只留 to
if so / if not / if necessary 常见省略式

examples.en: When asked, she gave the same answer.
examples.zh: 被问到时,她的回答一模一样。

examples.en: Though exhausted, the crew finished the night shoot.
examples.zh: 虽然筋疲力尽,剧组还是拍完了夜戏。

examples.en: He wanted to protest, but didn't dare (to).
examples.zh: 他想抗议,但不敢。

examples.en: Have you finished? If not, keep going.
examples.zh: 你做完了吗?没有的话就继续。

examples.en: The advice was sound, if slightly late.
examples.zh: 建议是靠谱的,只是有点迟。

questions.prompt: When ___ for directions, point at the map, not the sky.
options: asking
asked
you asking
to ask
questions.explanation: 省略式:when (you are) asked。

questions.prompt: Though ___ of sleep, she drove carefully.
options: depriving
deprived
deprives
deprive
questions.explanation: Though (she was) deprived of sleep。

questions.prompt: —Will you join the board? —I'd like ___, but I can't.
options: do
to
doing
so
questions.explanation: 省略不定式,保留 to。

questions.prompt: The soup was tasty, if ___ salty.
options: slight
slightly
slightness
more slight
questions.explanation: if 后省略 it was,保留副词 slightly。

questions.prompt: Which option correctly completes "If ___, call the duty desk"?
options: necessary
it necessity
necessarily
necessity
questions.explanation: if (it is) necessary 是固定省略式。

questions.prompt: He can play the fiddle, and his sister can ___, too.
options: it
that
so
this
questions.explanation: 用 so 替代前面提到的动作。

title: 独立主格结构
summary: 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语构成的独立结构,作状语补充背景,让描写更有层次。
points: 结构:名词 + 分词/形容词/副词/介词短语,与主句主语不同
with 复合结构:with + 名词 + 分词/形容词,更口语
表时间、原因、条件、伴随
逻辑主语与主句主语必须不同,否则用从句/省略
分词选 doing 还是 done:看与逻辑主语是主动还是被动

examples.en: The fog lifting, the ferries resumed.
examples.zh: 雾散了,渡轮复航。

examples.en: He stood at the helm, hands steady on the wheel.
examples.zh: 他站在舵轮前,双手稳稳把着轮。

examples.en: The last guest gone, we stacked the chairs.
examples.zh: 最后一位客人走后,我们把椅子摞了起来。

examples.en: With the generator off, the cabin went silent.
examples.zh: 发动机关掉后,船舱安静下来。

examples.en: Her voice hoarse, the guide whispered the last legend.
examples.zh: 嗓子哑了,向导低声讲完最后一个传说。

questions.prompt: The meeting ___, everyone drifted to the buffet.
options: over
was over
is over
to be over
questions.explanation: 独立主格保留名词 + 形容词/副词原形,不再带动词:over。

questions.prompt: Weather ___, the match will go ahead.
options: permitting
permitted
permits
to permit
questions.explanation: weather permitting 是独立主格:主动关系用 permitting。

questions.prompt: ___ her shoes caked in mud, she tiptoed across the floor.
options: With
As
For
Of
questions.explanation: with 复合结构:with + 名词 + 分词。

questions.prompt: The coach sat motionless, his eyes ___ on the scoreboard.
options: fixed
fixing
to fix
fix
questions.explanation: eyes 与 fix 是被动关系,用过去分词 fixed。

questions.prompt: Which sentence contains a nominative absolute (独立主格)?
options: The signal given, the divers dropped.
The divers dropped when the signal was given.
Giving the signal, the divers dropped.
The signal was given and the divers dropped.
questions.explanation: 名词 + 过去分词独立结构作时间状语,是独立主格。

questions.prompt: ___, the choir dispersed after the final chord.
options: The anthem sung
The anthem singing
Sung the anthem
The anthem to sing
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 + 过去分词(被动)构成独立主格:The anthem sung。

title: 衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练
summary: 用 however、therefore、in contrast 等衔接词把长难句、虚拟、倒装、强调串成连贯语篇,并做全年综合自测。
points: 转折:however, nevertheless, on the contrary, in contrast
因果:therefore, consequently, as a result, hence
递进/补充:moreover, furthermore, what is more
顺序与总结:first, then, finally, in short, to sum up
衔接词选错会颠倒逻辑:先判断两句关系再选词

examples.en: The pilot was delayed; therefore, the whole schedule slipped.
examples.zh: 飞行员迟到,因此整个日程都顺延了。

examples.en: The data looked solid; however, the sample was tiny.
examples.zh: 数据看起来扎实,然而样本极小。

examples.en: Moreover, the trend has repeated in three markets.
examples.zh: 此外,这一趋势已在三个市场重演。

examples.en: In short, the campaign worked despite the budget.
examples.zh: 总之,尽管预算有限,活动还是奏效了。

examples.en: Had we known the risks, we would never have set sail; nevertheless, the voyage taught us plenty.
examples.zh: 早知风险我们绝不会出海;不过这趟航行让我们学到很多。

questions.prompt: The hotel was fully booked; ___, we found a room nearby.
options: therefore
however
moreover
hence
questions.explanation: 前后是转折关系(订满了却找到房),用 however。

questions.prompt: Sales doubled; ___, the board doubled the marketing budget.
options: consequently
nevertheless
in contrast
instead
questions.explanation: 因果:销量翻倍,于是预算翻倍,用 consequently。

questions.prompt: The instructions were clear. ___, the volunteers needed a briefing.
options: Moreover
Similarly
Nevertheless
Therefore
questions.explanation: 前后转折:清晰但志愿者仍需培训,用 Nevertheless。

questions.prompt: ___, let me thank the crew and recap tonight's plan.
options: In contrast
To begin with
To sum up
Even so
questions.explanation: 结尾总结场景,用 To sum up。

questions.prompt: ___ the delays, the festival broke even.
options: Despite
Although
However
Nevertheless
questions.explanation: 后接名词短语 the delays,用介词 Despite。

questions.prompt: Had the alarm worked, the warehouse ___ .
options: would not burn
would not have burned
did not burn
had not burned
questions.explanation: 综合演练:与过去相反的虚拟 + 结尾语篇,选 would not have burned。

title: 分词完成式与被动式:having done / being done
summary: having done 表分词动作先于谓语且主动;being done 表进行中被动的含义,多作状语或介词宾语。
points: having done:主动且先发生(Having finished, he left.)
having been done:被动且先发生
being done:正在被…,作状语或介词宾语
done(过去分词):被动或完成,无时间先后强调
doing 与谓语同时发生
独立使用时注意逻辑主语与主句主语一致

examples.en: Having signed the contract, the manager shook hands with us.
examples.zh: 签完合同后,经理和我们握手。

examples.en: The problem being discussed is far from simple.
examples.zh: 正在讨论的问题绝不简单。

examples.en: Having been warned twice, he still made the same mistake.
examples.zh: 被警告过两次,他仍然犯同样的错误。

questions.prompt: ___ the whole novel, she wrote a detailed review.
options: Reading
Having read
Being read
Read
questions.explanation: 读完在写评论之前,主动完成用 Having read。

questions.prompt: ___ many times, the song sounds familiar to everyone.
options: Hearing
Having heard
Having been heard
Heard
questions.explanation: 歌被听了很多次,被动完成作状语。

questions.prompt: ___ in public made him nervous.
options: Correcting
Being corrected
Having corrected
Correct
questions.explanation: 动名词被动式作主语:Being corrected。

questions.prompt: ___ his homework, the boy went out to play football.
options: Finishing
Having finished
To finish
Finished
questions.explanation: 先完成作业再出去,用 Having finished。

questions.prompt: The bridge ___ now will open next spring.
options: built
being built
having built
to build
questions.explanation: 正在被修建,用 being built。

questions.prompt: ___ from space, the earth looks like a blue ball.
options: Seeing
Having seen
Seen
Being seen
questions.explanation: 地球被看,一般被动用 Seen。

title: 主谓一致进阶:就近与就远原则
summary: or/nor/not only...but also 就近一致;as well as/with/along with/together with 就远一致;集体名词看语境。
points: 就近原则:either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also, or
就远原则:as well as, with, along with, together with, except
集体名词(family/team/class)强调整体用单数,强调成员用复数
a number of + 复数动词;the number of + 单数动词
each/every/many a + 单数动词
one of + 复数名词 + 单数动词

examples.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was invited.
examples.zh: 不仅学生,连老师也被邀请了。

examples.en: Tom, as well as his brothers, enjoys swimming.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他的兄弟们都喜欢游泳。

examples.en: The number of tourists is rising this year.
examples.zh: 今年游客数量在上升。

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the workers ___ satisfied with the plan.
options: is
was
were
be
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近原则,workers 复数 → were。

questions.prompt: The teacher, together with his students, ___ going camping.
options: are
is
were
been
questions.explanation: together with 就远原则,主语 teacher 单数 → is。

questions.prompt: The number of private cars ___ increasing rapidly.
options: are
is
have been
were
questions.explanation: the number of + 单数动词。

questions.prompt: A number of students ___ failed the exam this time.
options: has
have
is
was
questions.explanation: a number of + 复数动词。

questions.prompt: Every man and every woman ___ asked to attend.
options: are
is
were
have been
questions.explanation: every...and every... 仍接单数动词。

questions.prompt: My family ___ a big dinner every Spring Festival Eve.
options: has
have
having
are having
questions.explanation: 强调整体习惯,用单数 has。

title: 替代与省略:one / that / do so
summary: one 替代泛指单数可数名词;that 替代特指不可数/可数名词且带后置定语;do so 替代前面提到的动作。
points: one = a + 单数可数名词,泛指
ones 复数;it 特指同一物
that = the + 名词,后常接 of/against 等介词短语
those = the + 复数
do so 替代"动词+宾语"的重复
so 替代表语/宾语从句:I think so

examples.en: I need a pen. Can you lend me one?
examples.zh: 我需要一支笔。能借我一支吗?

examples.en: The population of China is larger than that of the US.
examples.zh: 中国人口比美国多。

examples.en: He asked me to hand in the report and I did so at once.
examples.zh: 他让我交报告,我立刻照做了。

questions.prompt: The weather in Beijing is colder than ___ in Guangzhou.
options: it
one
that
this
questions.explanation: 替代特指的 weather,用 that。

questions.prompt: I've lost my umbrella; I must buy ___.
options: it
one
that
ones
questions.explanation: 泛指任意一把,用 one。

questions.prompt: The roofs of the cottages are older than ___ of the church.
options: this
that
those
ones
questions.explanation: 替代复数 roofs,用 those。

questions.prompt: — Will you join the club? — I believe ___.
options: so
one
that
it
questions.explanation: I believe so 替代宾语从句。

questions.prompt: She asked me to close the door, and I ___.
options: did so
did one
made so
so did
questions.explanation: 照做用 did so。

questions.prompt: My shoes are worn out. I'll buy new ___.
options: it
one
ones
that
questions.explanation: 替代复数 shoes,用 ones。

title: 插入语与同位语:长难句打断点
summary: 双逗号/双破折号间的插入语可先跳过;同位语对名词进一步说明,帮助拆解长难句。
points: 插入语:however, in fact, of course, as a result 等独立成分
同位语(名词短语):my friend Tom
同位语从句:the fact/news/idea that...(that 不作成分)
非限制性定语从句也起插入打断作用
拆句技巧:先去插入语找主干,再逐层还原
破折号与冒号后的内容常为解释说明

examples.en: The news that our team won the match excited everyone.
examples.zh: 我们队获胜的消息让所有人兴奋。

examples.en: Mr Smith, our headmaster, will give a speech tomorrow.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生——我们的校长——明天将发表演讲。

examples.en: This solution, in my opinion, is the most practical.
examples.zh: 依我看,这个方案最实用。

questions.prompt: The fact ___ he failed the exam surprised nobody.
options: which
that
what
who
questions.explanation: 同位语从句,that 不作成分。

questions.prompt: Word came ___ the mayor would visit our school.
options: which
that
what
where
questions.explanation: word(消息)后的同位语从句用 that。

questions.prompt: The proposal ___ the two sides discussed yesterday was accepted.
options: that
which
what
whose
questions.explanation: discussed 缺宾语,是定语从句,用 which。

questions.prompt: Tom, ___ opinion I value most, disagreed with the plan.
options: who
whose
which
that
questions.explanation: whose opinion 定语从句表所属。

questions.prompt: ____, the experiment turned out to be a success.
options: To our surprise
To we surprise
For our surprising
Surprising us
questions.explanation: To our surprise 为固定插入语。

questions.prompt: The thought ___ he might be wrong never crossed his mind.
options: which
that
if
unless
questions.explanation: thought 后同位语从句,句子成分完整,用 that。

title: 比较结构进阶:the more...the more 与倍数表达
summary: 成比例增长用"the + 比较级,the + 比较级";倍数用"倍数 + as...as / 比较级 than / the size of"。
points: The more..., the more...:越…越…(成比例变化)
The harder you work, the luckier you get.
倍数 + as + 原级 + as:twice as large as
倍数 + 比较级 + than:three times larger than
倍数 + the size/length/number of
比较对象要对应:The weather here is colder than that there.

examples.en: The more you practise, the better you speak.
examples.zh: 练习越多,说得越好。

examples.en: This hall is twice as large as that one.
examples.zh: 这个厅是那个厅的两倍大。

examples.en: The sooner, the better.
examples.zh: 越快越好。

questions.prompt: ___ you learn, ___ you realise how little you know.
options: More; more
The more; the more
The most; the most
Much; much
questions.explanation: "越…越…"结构:the + 比较级。

questions.prompt: This rope is three times ___ that one.
options: as long as
longer as
as longer as
so long than
questions.explanation: 倍数 + as + 原级 + as。

questions.prompt: The new bridge is ___ the old one.
options: twice the width of
twice wider of
twice width of
two time the width of
questions.explanation: 倍数 + the width of 结构。

questions.prompt: ___ you climb, ___ the air becomes.
options: More; thinner
The higher; the thinner
The more high; the more thin
Highest; thinnest
questions.explanation: 成比例变化用 the + 比较级结构。

questions.prompt: The output this year is ___ last year.
options: 50 percent higher than
50 percent as high than
50 percent higher as
as 50 percent high as
questions.explanation: 倍数/百分比 + 比较级 + than。

questions.prompt: The population of Shanghai is larger than ___ of London.
options: those
it
that
one
questions.explanation: 替代 population 用 that。

title: 情态动词完成式:must / should / could have done
summary: 对过去的推测与评价:must have done(肯定发生过)、should have done(本应)、needn't have done(本不必)。
points: must have done:过去一定发生过(肯定推测)
can't/couldn't have done:过去不可能
should/ought to have done:本应做而未做(责备)
shouldn't have done:本不该做却做了
could have done:本能够做却没做
needn't have done:本不必做却做了

examples.en: The ground is wet; it must have rained last night.
examples.zh: 地面是湿的,昨晚一定下过雨。

examples.en: You should have told me earlier.
examples.zh: 你本应早点告诉我。

examples.en: You needn't have brought so much food.
examples.zh: 你本不必带这么多吃的。

questions.prompt: She looks pale. She ___ ill.
options: must be
must have been
should be
can be
questions.explanation: 对过去状态的肯定推测:must have been(此刻看起来苍白是过去生病导致)。

questions.prompt: You ___ the letter; I had already posted it for you.
options: must post
should post
needn't have posted
can't post
questions.explanation: 本不必做却做了:needn't have done。

questions.prompt: He ___ the exam; he never opened the book.
options: can pass
could have passed
can't have passed
should pass
questions.explanation: 不可能通过:can't have passed。

questions.prompt: I'm sorry I was late; I ___ earlier.
options: should start
should have started
must start
could start
questions.explanation: 本应早点出发:should have started。

questions.prompt: With a bit more effort, we ___ the match.
options: could win
could have won
must have won
should win
questions.explanation: 本能够赢却没赢:could have won。

questions.prompt: You ___ him the news; it made him so sad.
options: shouldn't have told
shouldn't tell
mustn't tell
needn't tell
questions.explanation: 本不该告诉(已发生):shouldn't have told。

title: 含蓄条件句:without / but for / otherwise
summary: 不用 if 也能暗示条件:介词短语 without/but for 与副词 otherwise 暗含虚拟条件,时态按虚拟规则选。
points: Without/But for + 名词 = If it were not for / had not been for
与现在事实相反:would/should + 动词原形
与过去事实相反:would have + 过去分词
otherwise = if not(否则),暗含前句条件
but that + 从句也表"若不是"
判断技巧:看暗含条件指向现在还是过去

examples.en: Without your help, I would have failed.
examples.zh: 没有你的帮助,我就失败了。

examples.en: But for the rain, we would have arrived on time.
examples.zh: 要不是下雨,我们就准时到了。

examples.en: I was busy that day; otherwise I would have come.
examples.zh: 那天我很忙,否则我就来了。

questions.prompt: ___ your advice, we would have taken the wrong road.
options: Without
If
Unless
Because of
questions.explanation: 要不是你的建议,用 Without 表含蓄条件。

questions.prompt: But for the storm, the ship ___ on time.
options: arrives
would arrive
would have arrived
arrived
questions.explanation: 对过去的含蓄虚拟:would have arrived。

questions.prompt: I didn't know your number; otherwise I ___ you.
options: called
would call
would have called
had called
questions.explanation: otherwise 指过去:would have called。

questions.prompt: Without air, there ___ no living things on earth.
options: is
would be
will be
were
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的含蓄虚拟:would be。

questions.prompt: ___ the heavy traffic, we would have caught the train.
options: But for
If
Though
As for
questions.explanation: 要不是堵车,用 But for。

questions.prompt: He was not free yesterday; otherwise he ___ to the meeting.
options: would come
came
would have come
had come
questions.explanation: otherwise 指过去,用 would have come。

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 要点精讲
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
points: if + past (be uniformly were)
main clause would/could/might + base verb
expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
were is used for all persons
if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go

examples.en: If I were you, I would take the chance.
examples.zh: 如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。

examples.en: If he had more time, he would learn music.
examples.zh: 如果他有更多时间,他会学音乐。

examples.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to Rome.
examples.zh: 如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到罗马。

examples.en: If we started now, we would catch the train.
examples.zh: 如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。

examples.en: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
examples.zh: 如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。

examples.en: If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
examples.zh: 如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。

questions.prompt: If I _____ you, I would take the chance.
options: would be
were
was
am
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 were。句意:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If he had more time, he would learn music.
If he had more time, he will learn music.
If he had more time, he learned music.
If he had more time, he would learned music.
questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn music.

questions.prompt: 「如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到罗马。」的正确英文是?
options: If I were a bird, I can fly to Rome.
If I were a bird, I will fly to Rome.
If I were a bird, I could fly to Rome.
If I were a bird, I could flew to Rome.
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were a bird, I could fly to Rome.

questions.prompt: If we _____ now, we would catch the train.
options: start
started
would start
will start
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 started。句意:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
If she has known the answer, she would tell us.
If she knows the answer, she would tell us.
questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.

questions.prompt: 「如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。」的正确英文是?
options: If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
If I had the money, I bought a new computer.
If I had the money, I would bought a new computer.
If I had the money, I will buy a new computer.
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 要点精讲
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
points: if + had + past participle
main clause would/could have + past participle
expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
if omitted, invert: Had I known...
mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb

examples.en: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
examples.zh: 如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。

examples.en: If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
examples.zh: 如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。

examples.en: If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
examples.zh: 如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。

examples.en: If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
examples.zh: 如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。

examples.en: Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
examples.zh: 要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。

examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
examples.zh: 如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.

questions.prompt: 「如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。」的正确英文是?
options: If he had left earlier, he will have caught the train.
If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
If he had left earlier, he had caught the train.
If he had left earlier, he would catch the train.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.

questions.prompt: If we had taken a map, we _____ lost.
options: won't get
wouldn't have got
wouldn't get
hadn't got
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 wouldn't have got。句意:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If she had studied harder, she could pass.
If she had studied harder, she had passed.
If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.

questions.prompt: 「要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。」的正确英文是?
options: Have I seen you, I would have said hello.
Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
If I would see you, I would have said hello.
Did I see you, I would have said hello.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:Had I seen you, I would have said hello.

questions.prompt: If it _____, we would have gone out.
options: hasn't rained
wouldn't rain
didn't rain
hadn't rained
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 hadn't rained。句意:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。
